```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(tidyverse)
library(ggExtra)
library(gt)
```

```{r}
coad <- read.table("../data/many-cancers/MaxLimitsallLogExpr_coadread_AverageGeneExpr_vs_BUFFA_CorrelationScatterPlot_WP_ELECTRON_TRANSPORT_CHAIN_OXPHOS_SYSTEM_IN_MITOCHONDRIA.txt") %>%
  select(BUFFA_HYPOXIA_SCORE, AvgExpr) %>%
  rownames_to_column("sampleID") %>%
  mutate(cancer = "coad")

head(coad)

brca <- read.table("../data/many-cancers/MaxLimitsallLogExpr_brca_AverageGeneExpr_vs_BUFFA_CorrelationScatterPlot_WP_ELECTRON_TRANSPORT_CHAIN_OXPHOS_SYSTEM_IN_MITOCHONDRIA.txt") %>%
  select(BUFFA_HYPOXIA_SCORE, AvgExpr) %>%
  rownames_to_column("sampleID") %>%
  mutate(cancer = "brca")
```

```{r}
brca %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = BUFFA_HYPOXIA_SCORE, y = AvgExpr)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.2) +
  theme_bw() +
  stat_smooth(color = "red", lwd = 2) +
  labs(x = "Buffa Hypoxia Score",
       y = "mitoscore")
ggsave("../figures/scatterplot_buffa-mito_brca_gam.png",
       height = 3, width = 5)
```

```{r}
brca %>%
 mutate(pos = if_else(BUFFA_HYPOXIA_SCORE > 0,
                      true = "positive",
                      false = "negative")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = BUFFA_HYPOXIA_SCORE, y = AvgExpr)) +
  geom_point(aes(group = pos), alpha = 0.2) +
  theme_bw() +
  stat_smooth(aes(group = pos), method = "lm", color = "red", lwd = 2) +
  labs(x = "Buffa Hypoxia Score",
       y = "mitoscore")
ggsave("../figures/scatterplot_buffa-mito_brca_split-lm.png",
       height = 3, width = 5)
```

```{r}
comb <- 
  bind_rows(coad, brca)


comb %>%

ggsave("../figures/scatterplot_buffa-mito_brca+coad_lm.png",

```

# Now roll out to all cancers

```{r}
x <- data.frame(files = list.files("../data/many-cancers/", 
                                   full.names = TRUE)) %>%
  filter(grepl("\\.txt", files)) %>%
  filter(grepl("MaxLimitsall", files))
  

mitoscore.files <- x %>%
  filter(grepl("OXPHOS", files))
```

```{r}
readAndFilter <- function(table) {
  read.table(table) %>%
    select(BUFFA_HYPOXIA_SCORE, AvgExpr) %>%
    rownames_to_column("sampleID") %>%
    mutate(cancer = table) %>%
    mutate(cancer = gsub(pattern = ".*LogExpr_(.*)_AverageGene.*", 
                         replacement = "\\1",
                         x = cancer))
}

mitoscore <- lapply(X = mitoscore.files$files, readAndFilter) %>%
  bind_rows()

head(mitoscore)
dim(mitoscore)

mitoscore %>%
  group_by(cancer) %>%
  summarize(n = length(cancer)) %>%
  arrange(-n) %>%
  gt
```

```{r}
mitoscore %>%
 mutate(pos = if_else(BUFFA_HYPOXIA_SCORE > 0,
                      true = "positive",
                      false = "negative")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = BUFFA_HYPOXIA_SCORE, y = AvgExpr)) +
  geom_point(aes(group = pos), alpha = 0.2, color = "grey") +
  theme_bw() +
  stat_smooth(aes(group = pos), method = "lm", color = "red", lwd = 1.5) +
  labs(x = "Buffa Hypoxia Score",
       y = "mitoscore")
ggsave("../figures/scatterplot_buffa-mito_all_split-lm.png",
       height = 3, width = 5)
```

```{r}
mitoscore %>%
 mutate(pos = if_else(BUFFA_HYPOXIA_SCORE > 0,
                      true = "positive",
                      false = "negative")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = BUFFA_HYPOXIA_SCORE, y = AvgExpr)) +
  geom_point(aes(group = pos), alpha = 0.2, color = "grey") +
  theme_bw() +
  stat_smooth(aes(group = pos), method = "lm", color = "red", lwd = 1.5) +
  labs(x = "Buffa Hypoxia Score",
       y = "mitoscore") +
  facet_wrap(~cancer)
ggsave("../figures/scatterplot_buffa-mito_all_facet_split-lm.png",
       height = 10, width = 7.5)
```
